trace.question: Please provide the diagnosis of patients with ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase beyond the normal range by ascending order of their date of birth.
trace.evidence: ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase beyond the normal range refers to GPT > 60; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;

attempts.sql:
SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GPT > 60
GROUP BY p.ID
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC

trace.final_sql:
SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GPT > 60
GROUP BY p.ID
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
trace.answer: The query returned 90 diagnoses for patients with abnormal ALT levels, ordered from earliest to latest date of birth. The first entries include MRA, SLE, RA, Adult STILL, and SJS.
